sharpy.line.01: Why did you call me here, Ivo?
sharpy.line.02: I'm sorry for disturbing you Exetior, but you may need to look at this.

sharpy.line.06: The energy from these rings are on another level... something unexpected might come out of this.
sharpy.line.07: Interesting... I didn't think anyone had the balls to try and enter here without my permission.
sharpy.line.08: Come with me Ivo, I need you to help figure out exactly what's happening.
sharpy.line.09: Oh c'mon guys, sing with me! It'll be fun!
sharpy.line.12: UGHH! You guys are SOOOOO BORING!
sharpy.line.15: What great timing! Look what just appeared!
sharpy.line.17: It just came out of some big ring a couple minutes ago.
sharpy.line.18: It seems that there's some sort of energy radiating from the box, perhaps I can track where it came from...
sharpy.line.20: H-Hey, should we maybe test it? You know... singing and stuff... Just you and me-

warning_text_main:
WELCOME.

Before you continue any further, you have to be aware this mod contains flashing lights and seizures.

If you feel uncomfortable or triggered by these events, DO NOT PLAY THIS AND CLOSE THE GAME.

Also, if you have a weaker device, some issues with loading may occur. Please consider lowering shader quality or playing on a device with more RAM.

Viewer discretion is advised.
